content: Evolution API has no built-in rate limiter or job queue for bulk sends (GH issue #2538); maintainers gave no official safe messages/hour figure. Community figures put Baileys at roughly 10-20 msgs/min per instance before anti-spam triggers. Practitioner delay advice ranges widely: 1-5s (vendor blogs) up to 15-45s with a 10-15min rest every 50 messages (WasenderApi). The sendMedia 'delay' param is a typing/presence simulation before a single send, NOT a rate limiter. Root cause of most bans cited as unmanaged concurrency/burst traffic. All numbers are vendor opinion, not disclosed Meta thresholds.
